description: This PHP source file defines the SaveLeaveEntitlementController class within the OrangeHRM system. It handles the pre-render logic for managing leave entitlement records, including setup for editing or adding leave entitlements, access to related services, and preparing data for the front-end component rendering.

classes.name: SaveLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller that manages the pre-render process for leave entitlement editing or creation, integrating various services and preparing component properties.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the front-end component with necessary data such as leave entitlement details, subunits, locations, and leave periods before rendering.
